title: Template settings
description: A structured set of template settings, as the Configurator collects them. The per-setting types are checked against the base template's recipe, not here: this schema fixes the envelope.

base.description: The id of the template the settings are based on.

id.description: The id of the template to write. It becomes a directory name, so it is one safe path segment.

name.description: The human-facing name of the generated template.

workspace.description: The career workspace whose templates.local/ the template is written into.

settings.description: The chosen value per knob id. Every key must be a knob of the base template's recipe.
